abstract.t: DomainKeys Identified Mail v2 (DKIM2) requires any modifications made to email messages by intermediaries to be recorded in "recipes". Some originators wish to request that only very limited modifications be made to their messages so that the recipient of the message can have some assurance that the modifications were benign. This document introduces the CanModify header field into which originator requests may be placed. It then sets out a small set of modifications that are commonly applied by intermediaries and assesses how benign they may actually be.
